method: Seeded shuffle, duplicate exclusions, first 24 survivors; no keyword sampling
duplicate_rule: Casefolded word equality; 5-word shingle containment >=0.8 or Jaccard >=0.6, minimum 20 shingles
comparison_scope: 48 reviewed development quotes plus 150-word windows at stride 75 across their full source texts; within-test comparisons
limitation: Lexical screen cannot guarantee absence of paraphrases or semantic duplication. Human speech-boundary review still required.
